shots.description: Technischer Zustand aim; der Officer hat keine Contract-Clips.

actions.code:
(() => { const f=window.npcTest; f.setState('S1','aim'); f.step(0); f.inspect('S1');
          if(f.app.npcs.npcs.find(n=>n.id==='S1').stateMachine.state!=='aim') throw new Error('Wrong NPC state'); return f.stats(); })()
